TerrainDef.label: wraith gravship substructure
TerrainDef.description: A living load-bearing deck grown inside a Wraith gravitic field. It is true Odyssey substructure and belongs only to the Wraith gravship family.

ThingDef.label: wraith gravship hull tissue
ThingDef.description: Dense self-repairing hull tissue grown over Wraith gravship substructure. The family protects itself through living-hull repair rather than a generic energy shield.

ThingDef.label: wraith gravship sphincter
ThingDef.description: A living airtight aperture grown into a Wraith gravship hull.

ThingDef.label: wraith grav-field lobe
ThingDef.description: A living lobe extending the Wraith grav engine's substructure-support field.

ThingDef.label: wraith gravship pilot node
ThingDef.description: A neural command organ linked to the Wraith grav engine and the isolated Wraith neural power grid.

ThingDef.label: wraith bio-fluid bladder
ThingDef.description: A living Odyssey fuel reservoir. It accepts only Wraith bio-fluid and only contributes fuel when physically connected to a same-family drive through Wraith fuel conduits.

ThingDef.label: large wraith bio-fluid bladder
ThingDef.description: A mature living Wraith fuel reservoir for long-range gravships.

ThingDef.label: wraith organic fuel conduit
ThingDef.description: A living vascular line that carries Wraith bio-fluid between same-family fuel bladders and drive organs. It is not an electrical conduit.

ThingDef.label: wraith neural power conduit
ThingDef.description: A living nerve trunk carrying only Wraith-family gravship power. It cannot join vanilla or Asuran grids.

ThingDef.label: wraith power coupler
ThingDef.description: An intentional electro-neural interface between a vanilla colony power net and an isolated Wraith neural grid. It never bridges directly into Asuran power.

ThingDef.label: wraith gravship metabolic heart
ThingDef.description: A ship-grown metabolic heart supplying Wraith neural power and circulating repair biomass through nearby living hull and organs.

ThingDef.label: wraith gravship drive organ
ThingDef.description: A living Odyssey drive organ. It requires matching Wraith substructure, neural power, and a physical bio-fluid feed path.

ThingDef.label: greater wraith drive organ
ThingDef.description: A mature high-output Wraith drive organ for large living gravships.

ThingDef.label: wraith drive synchronizer
ThingDef.description: A living drive regulator that reduces native Odyssey gravship fuel expenditure.

ThingDef.label: Asuran grav engine
ThingDef.description: A synthesized Asuran grav engine. It is a real Odyssey Building_GravEngine and only links to Asuran-family facilities.

TerrainDef.label: Asuran gravship substructure
TerrainDef.description: A precision nanite-composite deck synchronized only to an Asuran grav engine family.

ThingDef.label: Asuran gravship hull
ThingDef.description: A seamless nanite-composite airtight hull grown over Asuran gravship substructure.

ThingDef.label: Asuran gravship door
ThingDef.description: A seamless airtight aperture in an Asuran nanite-composite hull.

ThingDef.label: Asuran grav-field projector
ThingDef.description: A precision projector extending an Asuran grav engine's substructure-support envelope.

ThingDef.label: Asuran gravship pilot console
ThingDef.description: A precision Asuran command console linked only to an Asuran grav engine and Asuran power lattice.

ThingDef.label: Asuran nanite-slurry fuel cell
ThingDef.description: An Odyssey fuel reservoir that accepts only stabilized Asuran nanite slurry and requires a same-family physical fuel feed.

ThingDef.label: large Asuran nanite-slurry fuel cell
ThingDef.description: A high-density Asuran gravship fuel reservoir.

ThingDef.label: Asuran nanite fuel conduit
ThingDef.description: A shielded feed line carrying only Asuran nanite slurry between same-family cells and vector drives.

ThingDef.label: Asuran gravship power conduit
ThingDef.description: An isolated nanite-composite power bus. It cannot join Wraith or ordinary colony grids without an explicit Asuran power coupler.

ThingDef.label: Asuran power coupler
ThingDef.description: An intentional interface between a vanilla colony power net and an isolated Asuran gravship lattice. It never bridges directly into Wraith neural power.

ThingDef.label: Asuran vacuum power cell
ThingDef.description: A finite ship-scale Asuran power cell. It consumes reconstructed vacuum-energy modules and energizes only the Asuran family lattice.

ThingDef.label: Asuran gravship vector drive
ThingDef.description: A precision Odyssey vector drive requiring same-family power and a physical Asuran nanite-slurry feed.

ThingDef.label: greater Asuran vector drive
ThingDef.description: A high-output Asuran vector drive for full-scale precursor gravships.

ThingDef.label: Asuran vector optimizer
ThingDef.description: A precision drive synchronizer reducing native Odyssey gravship fuel expenditure.
